title: Example worker decisions
description: Fictional example of the Example Scheduler, a made-up job scheduler; not a description of any real system.

entities.title: Store leases in the database
entities.summary: Slot leases live in the jobs database, not in a cache.
entities.context: Workers must agree on who runs a slot, even after a restart.

options.title: Database row lock
options.consequences: One more write per run; survives restarts.

options.title: In-memory cache
options.consequences: Fast; lost on restart, so slots can run twice.

entities.rationale: A double run costs more than a write.

entities.title: Group repeated alarms per hour or per day
entities.summary: How long repeated failures of one job are grouped.
entities.context: Grouping per hour may page too often for a job that fails all night.
